name: Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le considérant M - Am 17
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: Ma. whereas the current Mexican Government has taken significant steps towards a more inclusive economic model, including substantial increases in the national minimum wage, the expansion of social protection programmes and the strengthening of workers’ pension rights; whereas these policies have contributed to measurable improvements in living standards and are broadly aligned with the EU’s objectives of social cohesion and inclusive growth; whereas such convergence of social and economic values constitutes a solid foundation on which to deepen the political relationship between the EU and Mexico;
